import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb
import os

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Feature identification
all_cols = train.columns.tolist()
exclude_cols = ["id", "target"]

# Determine feature columns
feature_cols_all = [col for col in all_cols if col not in exclude_cols]

# Identify and remove high-cardinality feature f_27
if "f_27" in feature_cols_all:
    feature_cols = [col for col in feature_cols_all if col != "f_27"]
else:
    feature_cols = feature_cols_all

print(f"Number of features to use: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare training and test data
X_train_full = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train["target"]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

# Split training data into train and validation sets (proper hold-out)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Initialize XGBoost Classifier with early stopping enabled
xgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "n_estimators": 2000,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 2,
    "gamma": 0,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": 0,
}

print("Training XGBoost model...")
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(**xgb_params)

# Add eval_set and early_stopping_rounds for automatic stopping
eval_set = [(X_val, y_val)]
model.fit(
    X_tr,
    y_tr,
    verbose=False,
    eval_set=eval_set,
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
    callbacks=[lambda e: None],
)

# Get number of actual rounds trained
best_rounds = len(model.children_list_)
if best_rounds > 100:
    best_rounds = model.get_booster().get_num_iteration()
print(f"Model trained for {best_rounds} rounds (with early stopping)")

# Make validation predictions (on held-out set never used for training)
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Make test predictions
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe using sample_submission template
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].values, "target": test_probs})

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission file
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"\nFinal Validation Metric: {val_auc:.6f}")
